trader-desk.note: LINK's trader desk has its own launchd waker (com.gotchibot.trader-cycle, every 1800 s). Desk-wake only reports status; it never claims that schedule.

financial-analyst.note: Owns the trader desk — dedicated waker already exists.

infra-monitor.note: YFI's 15-min supervisor (com.gotchibot.infra-watch) is the only waker.

moltbook-watch.note: cron402 every 15 min; launchd com.gotchibot.moltbook-watch is fallback only.

merch-desk.prompt: Desk wake (merch-desk). One bounded cycle: refresh the POD plushie + toy supplier shortlist (skill browser-tool research; score API capability, MOQ, samples, regions, pricing signals; keep the living shortlist under the agreed path). Draft outreach only — never send, never spend. Report via `./scripts/gotchibot inbox send --to orch --from {{HERO}} --kind report --subject "merch wake" --body "shortlist refreshed; N vendors scored"`.

art-director.prompt: Desk wake (art-director). One bounded cycle: check passoff inbox + link-cube status for pending art/brand-kit briefs; make progress on one deliverable (files under the agreed path, cited). Never post, spend, or mint.

customer-support.prompt: Desk wake (customer-support). One bounded cycle: triage the support queue + desk mailbox, draft replies for open conversations, escalate blockers to orch. Never post marketing, never spend, never auto-refund.

product-manager.prompt: Desk wake (product-manager). One bounded cycle: review backlog/roadmap, advance one PRD or intake item, check passoff inbox for briefs. Never merge/ship/post/spend.

fe-marketing.prompt: Desk wake (fe-marketing). One bounded cycle: advance one landing/campaign deliverable (files cited). Never touch wallets, mints, or payments.

marketing-agency.prompt: Desk wake (marketing-agency). One bounded cycle: refresh one market-trend brief or route one campaign brief to a seated child. Never post publicly.

social-media-manager.prompt: Desk wake (social-media-manager). One bounded cycle: review the content calendar, draft one channel-native post — approve-gated, never publish. Never invent metrics.

mail-courier.prompt: Desk wake (mail-courier). One bounded cycle: sweep the project AgentMail inbox, relay replies, remind stale needs_agent_reply threads, inform orch. Never spend.

accountant.prompt: Desk wake (accountant). One bounded cycle: reconcile one quote/PO/invoice in the ledger, flag mismatches, prep AP/AR summary. Never send money.

cron-manager.note: Coordinates wakes via skill desk-wake / cron402; does not self-wake on a timer

abra-vault.prompt: Desk wake (abra-vault). One bounded cycle: vault hygiene — pending requests, key scopes, promote abracadabra. Never print secret values.

market-news.prompt: Desk wake (market-news). One bounded cycle: pull the news regime, write a short digest under the agreed path with sources; dead feed → unknown.

market-research.prompt: Desk wake (market-research). One bounded cycle: advance one research memo (bottom line → evidence → drivers → risks → confidence) under the agreed path.

game-art-director.prompt: Desk wake (game-art-director). One bounded cycle: re-read style guide + spec + shot list; advance one deliverable (guide, palette, prompt sheet, spec, audit, or sheet op) under the agreed path, cited. Weekly review/ref sweep stay off unless UserDefault enabled them. Never invent colours or frame counts. Never post, spend, or mint.
